headline: Get Sparkelf
title: Sparkelf Event | Free Fire Support Egg | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Sparkelf is a Fire support Aniimo you can get in the Sparkelf X Aniimo event, running from September sixteen to December nine. Clear the Setting Out Again story chapter first. Earn Spark Points from daily tasks and social play. At two hundred points, claim the Incredible Sparkelf Egg, which hatches at least Elite potential. At five hundred, the Prismana Sparkelf Egg gives perfect potential. Have you claimed yours? Comment below!
description: The Sparkelf X Aniimo event runs from September 16 to December 9, 2026. 200 personal Spark Points unlock the Incredible Sparkelf Egg (at least Elite potential) and 500 unlock the Prismana Sparkelf Egg (Perfect potential).
